panels.title: Unhealthy workload pods

panels.title: Gateway connection and routing events
panels.description: Accepted clients plus bounded routing, backend, recovery, and handoff outcomes across the gateway pool.

panels.title: Gateway CPU pressure
panels.description: Average, hottest gateway, and the pod selected from the capacity table.

targets.expr: (avg(100 * sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="tcp-lab",container="gateway"}[30s])) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="tcp-lab",container="gateway",resource="cpu",unit="core"}))) or on() (vector(0) / 0)

(max(100 * sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="tcp-lab",container="gateway"}[30s])) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="tcp-lab",container="gateway",resource="cpu",unit="core"}))) or on() (vector(0) / 0)

panels.title: Gateway to server latency
panels.description: Application-level round trip from a gateway writing a command to its authoritative server through receiving the response. This excludes the external client-to-NLB path.
